lansing.role: state capital node — can see but not touch

layer_tuebors.description: each layer can have its own tuebor — its own defense

device.tuebor: orbit.js — defends the viewport boundary. scrollbar-gutter is the crust.

outer_membrane.tuebor: signal + gorilla + lansing — defends the entry points. what visitors see first.

peptidoglycan.tuebor: tuebor.primals.eco — defends the structural analysis. 51 investigations, 8 threads.

inner_membrane.tuebor: detroit + barry + clutch — defends the evidence. court records, FOIA, actors.

cytoplasm.tuebor: hypothesis + thesis + sporeprint — defends the theory. the whitepaper. the methodology.

signal_path.description: a reporter goes into a mine field and gets signal UP
path: inner_membrane: evidence collected → court records, FOIA, actors documented
peptidoglycan: analysis written → 51 articles, 8 clusters organized
outer_membrane: signal broadcast → visitors arrive, fleet classified
device: membrane rendered → observer sees, hears, interacts
signal_path.direction: UP — signal rises through the layers
signal_path.inversion: the voice goes DOWN — inside from outside, outside from inside

blend_result: 13 of 16 hypotheses have implementations in the system that weren't formally connected. the blend reveals: the architecture IS the whitepaper. the code IS the proof.
